Guillermo's own take for Fri, Nov 6 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Gale day in the Strait. At 5am Sand Heads reads E 20 and Halibut Bank ENE 23 gusting 28: right on size, still more east than the page's SE. Environment Canada has southeast 35 this morning, easing to 20 to 30 by noon.

My pick is Boundary Bay from noon to 5:30pm, SSE 20 to 24 gusting 30. You need 10ft of tide, so not before noon (high 13.6ft at 3:47pm). Advanced riders: Tsawwassen south side, 22 to 28 with 2ft waves. Go if Sand Heads has swung SE by 11am.
